summary: Closure review: the authors have addressed the prior required revisions. The manuscript now uses numbered IEEE-style references with full bibliographic metadata and contains the explicit Methods sentence noting model_configuration.json records temperature = null (unset) and that null/unset is not evidence of deterministic provider-side sampling; it also reiterates that exactly one sampled initial generation per task was reused by both arms (shared_initial_candidate). The study execution, preregistration fidelity, disclosure, and artifact grounding remain transparent; the degenerate (ceiling) confirmatory outcome is correctly diagnosed and framed. No remaining critical issues block finalisation.
optional_revisions: Consider removing or minimizing explicit internal file paths and raw SHA-256 digests from the main prose (leave them in the archived evidence bundle) and instead point high-level readers to the archived artifact inventory for reproducibility checks.

Optionally add one concise sentence in Methods or Disclosure noting that full verified bibliographic records used to assemble the References section are preserved in the archived evidence bundle (give only the preregistration identifier for cross-checking, not internal artifact paths).
